items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area (e.g., counseling, social work, education) or equivalent combination of education and experience/training.
Master's degree in related area (e.g., counseling, social work, education) or equivalent combination of education and experience/training.
Experience in providing services to students with disabilities at the post-secondary level.
Experience maintaining confidential records and communications.
Experience in evaluating student requests for academic adjustments and determining reasonable accommodations.
Experience in advising students with disabilities about disability strategies and management; in providing crisis response; and in making appropriate referrals.

Under the general direction of the Student Disability Center (SDC) Executive Director, provide a range of academic accommodations for students with disabilities such as access, proctoring, or note-taking. Within this range, independently evaluate student accommodation requests in accordance with UC policy and federal/state law to recommend and coordinate reasonable and appropriate academic accommodations. Consult with SDC Executive Director for guidance on more complex issues. Serve as a junior member of the SDC Specialist team, represent and deliver SDC outreach programs, and other projects as assigned.
65% - Determination of Eligibility and Coordination of Services/Reasonable Accommodations
Expertise in interpreting documentation and determining appropriate accommodations.
Knowledge of appropriate diagnostic and screening instruments required for evaluation of visual, mobility, and medical disabilities.
Knowledge of public school accommodations that may be part of students' prior educational history.
Knowledge of disability accommodation procedures and strategies for college students with disabilities.
Skill to handle conflict in a respectful manner. Flexibility to support organizational changes, departmental priorities, activities and assignments.
Knowledge of University/departmental policies and practices, including ethical requirements.
